scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @werewolf/server" "npm run dev -w @werewolf/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @werewolf/shared && npm run build -w @werewolf/server && npm run build -w @werewolf/web && npm --prefix avalon run build && npm --prefix bloodbound run build && npm --prefix skullking run build && cp game-selector/index.html apps/web/dist/index.html && cp game-selector/launcher.css apps/web/dist/launcher.css
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @werewolf/shared && npm run typecheck -w @werewolf/server && npm run typecheck -w @werewolf/web
